## Fitness as empowerment

Under the theme *MYbharat Viksit Bharat*, Megh Foundation and NYKS Gandhinagar hosted the Nari Shakti Fitness Run to spotlight women's health as a development priority.

## More than a run

The event included awareness sessions on nutrition, mental health, and physical wellbeing, with experts and community leaders contributing to actionable discussion.

## Development lens

A developed society is built by healthy, confident citizens. Women's wellbeing is not a side issue - it is a foundation of social progress.
